notes: Step images are small and many subassemblies are ambiguous; piece-to-piece attachments are best-effort. Piece counts per type match the official inventory (215 main parts + 20 in the 4x rotor-blade repeat = 235).

Ids are grouped by assembly (fuselage b1-b41, nose/cockpit b42-b91, windows/doors, tail b107-b134, rotor-mount b135-b160, winch b161-b168, landing gear b169-b195, main rotor b196-b204, stretcher b205-b207), not strictly in page order. b212-b215 were added last to match the inventory.

Connectivity fix: the stretcher (b205) is now joined to the winch hook (b168), as the cover and rescue scene show it hanging from the cord. The booklet does not physically attach the minifigure accessories (binoculars b208, briefcase b209, circular saw b210, radio b211); they are held by minifigures, which are not in the parts list, so they are linked with `contact` edges only (radio at the cockpit panel b66, the others resting on the cabin floor b7) rather than being left as isolated groups. These contact edges are an assumption, not a build step.
Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, helmets) are not in the official parts list so are not nodes. The sticker sheet b160 has only a contact edge to the panel b158.
Windscreen b91 is attached to hinge brick b29, and the winch b162 to the other finger of b29; the exact hinge partners in the booklet are not clearly visible.
The four rotor blades are one repeat; copies 2-4 attach to rotor arms b198-b200 instead of b197. Main rotor hub b196 spins on the pin of b150.
Compound pieces such as the tail wings, door windows and wheel pairs follow my reading of steps; the identity of which red plates/bricks sit where on the nose is approximate.
